items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: "And that's why I told Rob. But I was not there when they told me about it, you know what I mean?"

ctx.x: Did he play anything except Sandpaper?

That's all, Sandpaper. He couldn't do nothing about Sandpaper. He left one day with Aberglenny. He's dead too. Aberglenny. You were the speaker. I'm from speaker. Joseph Davis and St. Paper George. They went to Berkey. And Aberglenny had his bass. And then I was dancing in the meantime, and when they got to play, and Aberglenny had his bass. And everybody was drinking, and St. Paper George had a glass of wine, and he said, it's a shame. Everybody drink, and that full thing right there, that full energy, give him…
Say, did the Golden Rule Band and the Imperial and Buddy Bolden's bands, and- It was the same at the same time.
